sections.section: ORDER - Presedent's Order 8, Distribution of Revenues Order 1983
sections.description:
ORDINANCE XIII OF 1983
DISTRIBUTION
OF REVENUES ORDER 1983
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 8 of 1983
[Gazette
of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part 1, 12th June, 1983]
No. F.
17(2)/83-Pub.-The following Order made by the President is hereby published for
general information :-
In pursuance of
the Proclamation of the fifth day of July. 1977, and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following
Order :-
1. Short
title and commencement.-(1) This Order may be
called the Distribution of Revenues Order, 1983.
(2) It shall
come into force on the first day of July, 1983.
2. Order to
override other laws.-The Provisions of this Order
shall have effect notwithstanding anything contained in any other law the for
time being in force.
3.
Distribution of Revenues.-The sum assigned to the
Provincial Governments under Article 3 of the Distribution of Revenues and
Grants-in- Aid Order, 1975 (P. O. No. 2 of 1975), shall be distributed amongst
the Provinces on the basis of their respective population in the percentage
specified against each :
The Punjab
57.97 %
Sind
23.34 %
The North-West Frontier Province
13.39 %
Baluchistan
5.30 %
Total
1000.00%
